pictures.inspected: Photo caption56: Садовый домик. Long two-level storage building with pale log lower walls, multiple broad lower wooden gates, weathered vertical-board upper room, continuous open upper gallery and timber stair descending right, broad red seamed hip roof. Trees obscure some front bays and the far side; exact lower gate count and rear inventory remain a reconstruction.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Complete mapped garden-house exterior interpretation: two-level apple storehouse with pale log lower room, weathered vertical-board upper room, broad red standing-seam hip roof, open front gallery and external twelve-tread stair. Three lower wooden gate openings and one upper gallery entrance are physically recessed; timber piers, railings, stringers and supported aprons complete the exterior. The independent named garden-house POI and its own mapped footprint remain distinct from the nearby granary. No copied signs, inscriptions, people, merchandise, furnishings or photograph pixels. Hidden rear inventory and precise historical levels remain reconstructed.
